summary: The agent provides a basic LightGBM solution but skips data cleaning and feature engineering. Critical issues include ignoring patient-level grouping during validation splitting (causing subject overlap) and using LabelEncoder on the test set without handling unseen categories, which can cause execution crashes. The evaluation is also limited to a single metric (accuracy) and a single split.
